risks.description: Long-lived page re-rendering from carousel could disrupt user scroll/focus.
risks.mitigation: Hero auto-advance now updates only hero state/DOM.

risks.description: Market-specific live prices/availability could be misrepresented.
risks.mitigation: All sample data is explicitly labelled as demo/illustrative.

risks.description: Remote official image URLs can fail or change.
risks.mitigation: No critical business logic depends on image availability; product image errors are tolerated visually.

risks.description: Real payment/order integrity is unvalidated because no payment backend exists.
risks.mitigation: Checkout is local-only and explicitly non-production.
